# Protogens
Protogens are not technically a species, but rather a broad term for a person that has modified themselves extensively with cybernetic enhancements that they can no longer be considered their own species anymore. Despite "Cyborg" already existing as a term, it was coined for machines that had organic brains, and as such a distinction needed to be made.
## Racial Features - They receive [color=#ffa500]20% more heat damage, 25% more shock damage and 10% more blunt damage[/color]. - Additionally, they receive [color=#1fb0ff]50% less cold damage[/color]. - On top of that, they receive [color=#1fb0ff](10%-30%-40%) slash and piercing damage resistance[/color] depending on their cybernetic choice. (Access your species specific loadout from the Appearance tab) - They have a [color=#1fb0ff]Built in MIDI player[/color] - Due to their mixed mechanical and biological nature, they can [color=#1fb0ff]heal with both chemicals and topicals, and welders and wires[/color], however [color=#ffa500]both methods are only 50% effective[/color]. - They are [color=#ffa500]damaged slightly and immobilised by EMPs[/color]. - They have an in-built [color=#1fb0ff]Trinary Radio Channel accessed with the key :D[/color] - Their claws deal [color=red]6[/color] slash damage with unarmed attacks. - They are so widespread that every species can be a protogen, combining their strengths and weaknesses with those of protogens to create something new.
## Trinary Protogens are able to speak and understand Trinary, a language similar to binary but able to be spoken by most synthetics.
## Origins and Names Protogens started as a body modification movement that quickly spread across the whole galaxy, gaining traction within all known species. Most protogens do not simply stop the modifications at their bodies, usually choosing to alter their names to include numbers and symbols or even adopting a silicon-like designation.
